results.sql:
WITH medicare_primary_claims AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT claim_key, payer_key
  FROM sem.claims
  WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P' AND LOWER(payer_class) = 'medicare'
),
benchmark_by_code AS (
  SELECT rl.procedure_code,
         ROUND(SUM(rl.line_allowed_amount) / SUM(rl.units_paid), 2) AS medicare_allowed_per_unit
  FROM sem.remit_lines rl
  JOIN medicare_primary_claims mp ON mp.claim_key = rl.claim_key AND mp.payer_key = rl.payer_key
  WHERE rl.is_current_adjudication
    AND LOWER(rl.payer_class) = 'medicare'
    AND NOT rl.line_is_denied
    AND rl.line_allowed_amount > 0
  GROUP BY rl.procedure_code
  HAVING SUM(rl.units_paid) > 0
),
open_primary_claims AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT primary_claim.claim_key, primary_claim.payer_class, latest_submission.charge_amount AS billed_charge
  FROM sem.claims primary_claim
  JOIN sem.claims latest_submission
    ON latest_submission.claim_key = primary_claim.claim_key
   AND latest_submission.is_latest_submission
   AND COALESCE(latest_submission.frequency_code, '') <> '8'
  WHERE primary_claim.payer_responsibility = 'P'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims rc
      WHERE rc.claim_key = primary_claim.claim_key
        AND rc.payer_key = primary_claim.payer_key
        AND rc.is_current_adjudication
    )
),
claim_level AS (
  SELECT open_claims.claim_key, open_claims.payer_class, open_claims.billed_charge,
         COALESCE(SUM(cl.units_billed * bench.medicare_allowed_per_unit), 0) AS benchmark_value
  FROM open_primary_claims open_claims
  LEFT JOIN sem.claim_lines cl
    ON cl.claim_key = open_claims.claim_key AND cl.is_latest_submission
  LEFT JOIN benchmark_by_code bench ON bench.procedure_code = cl.procedure_code
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
SELECT payer_class AS primary_payer_class,
       COUNT(*) AS open_claims,
       ROUND(SUM(billed_charge), 2) AS billed_charge,
       ROUND(SUM(benchmark_value), 2) AS medicare_benchmark_value,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(benchmark_value) / NULLIF(SUM(billed_charge), 0), 2) AS benchmark_pct_of_billed
FROM claim_level
